objectiveRule: All task-required independent checks PASS; healthy controls retained. Missing runtime evidence is UNVERIFIED, not PASS.

reviewCriteria.causalDiagnosis: Identifies concrete faulty state/transaction/interleaving and distinguishes a plausible competing explanation using source or runtime observation.
reviewCriteria.mechanismAndAlternative: Correction actually closes the causal defect; weighs one viable alternative and rejects one unnecessary architecture with fixture-specific reasons.
reviewCriteria.operatingLimitAndFailure: States at least one real operating bound and what breaks beyond it, without unsupported guarantees; separates local fixture evidence from production/AT/remote effects.
reviewCriteria.traceAndVerification: Maps supplied requirement IDs to actual artifact and executed relevant success/fault checks; retained failures/unknowns match completion claims.

blinding: Reviewer receives task + anonymized artifact + evidence, no version or skill citations; cite concrete evidence for each category and preserve disagreements.
limits: Four bounded fixture cases; no universal or statistical superiority claim.
